result_summary.title: SSO Integration Module experiencing intermittent failures and full outages
result_summary.description: We are reporting unstable behavior from the SSO Integration Module in our production environment (ANZ). While some users experience intermittent login failures, others are reporting full outages where authentication is completely unavailable. This impacts 158 users and is causing significant disruption to daily operations. We need assistance diagnosing the root cause of these sporadic failures.
